'''Kliyna Furthen''' was an individual that donated 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[Lightwind Orphanage]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kliyna Furthen was mentioned in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
